#!/bin/sh
count_file="$HOME/.s07-fake-count"
if [ "$1" = "--version" ]; then
  n=0
  if [ -r "$count_file" ]; then read n < "$count_file"; fi
  n=$((n + 1))
  printf '%s\n' "$n" > "$count_file"
  if [ "$n" -eq 1 ]; then sleep 3; printf '%s\n' 'FAKE_CANCELED_STARTUP_FINISHED'; exit 0; fi
  printf '%s\n' 'S07 fake sidecar 1.0'
  exit 0
fi
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case "$line" in
    *'"content":""'*)
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"system","subtype":"init","tools":["StructuredOutput"],"mcp_servers":[]}'
      continue ;;
    *'"request_id":"nshell-bootstrap-interrupt"'*)
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"control_response","response":{"subtype":"success","request_id":"nshell-bootstrap-interrupt","response":{"still_queued":[]}}}'
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[]}}'
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","is_error":true}'
      continue ;;
  esac
  printf '%s\n' '{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"echo S07_CANCEL_RECOVERY_RESULT"}]}}'
  printf '%s\n' '{"type":"result","subtype":"success","structured_output":{"command":"echo S07_CANCEL_RECOVERY_RESULT","reason":"cancel recovery fixture","risk":"low"}}'
done
